title: Working with windows
drDigitalIntro:
Every app opens in a window — a rectangle you can move and resize.
• Move a window by dragging the strip at the top with the app's name on it.
• Resize it by dragging the corner handle at the bottom-right.
• Minimize hides the window and leaves the app running in the dock. Maximize fills the screen.
• Close removes the window entirely.

playgroundTask.goal: You moved, resized, minimized, maximized, and closed a window

steps.say: Drag the strip at the top of the window — the one with the app's name on it — to move the window.
Drag the striped corner handle at the bottom-right to resize the window.
Click the − button to minimize the window.
Click the Notes icon in the dock at the bottom to bring the window back.
Click the □ button to maximize the window so it fills the screen.
Click the □ button again to restore the window to its normal size.
Click the ✕ button to close the window.

drDigitalSuccess: Moved, resized, hidden, filled the screen, and closed. There is nothing else a window does.
drDigitalHint: Look for the pulsing yellow ring — it shows exactly what to click or drag next.
